summary: Run UI kit Storybook and strict plays only when kit inputs change, and include Chromium/Playwright flake changes in web CI coverage.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No application or API change. App-only web CI events skip kit play index contracts, Storybook builds and strict plays with an explicit summary; kit, shared package configuration, workflow and flake changes retain those checks.
